evidence.title: Mega Or Q2 2026 report: MDCIL-2 Masmiyya data centre under construction as of June 30
evidence.excerpt: Mega Or's Q2 2026 report lists MDCIL-2 at Yoav plot 200A among data centres under construction and says the Masmiyya facility Mega D.C. is building is due for delivery in Q3 2026.

metadata.physical_status_scope: Broad under_construction for the MDCIL-2 facility on plot 200A. No building count, completion percentage, energization, delivery or operation is inferred; the Q3 2026 delivery is a forecast.
metadata.successor_review: The report signed on August 9 still describes delivery as future. A bounded search of the issuer's website and August reporting found no delivery, operation or cancellation announcement through August 20; an August 13 Calcalist Tech report (secondary, captured) still describes the Masmiyya centre as being built. Immediate reports on the TASE Maya system could not be captured because the service blocks automated retrieval; this is not an exhaustive filing audit.
